context: Two teens plan a summer outing
purpose: Teach: 七月/土日/新築/ハイテク/オープニング/芸能人/飛び込ん/渡る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 七月の連休、土日に新築のショッピングモール行こうよ。
lines.en: Let's go to the new mall this July break—Saturday and Sunday, yeah?
lines.style: Bright opening pitch, like she's already decided and is inviting him along. Quick tempo, confident. Small up-lift on the final particle, casual certainty.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。ハイテク家電のコーナー、芸能人もよく来るって。
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good. The high-tech section—I heard celebrities go there all the time.
lines.style: Playing it cool but genuinely interested. Slight pause before the new thought, like he's already picturing it. Warm, easy tone. Not trying to impress, just sharing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: オープニングセールに飛び込んで、人気商品ゲットしたい。
lines.en: I want to jump on the opening sale and actually score one of the hot items.
lines.style: Eyes bright with wanting. Faster tempo, like the energy is catching her. Playful determination — not desperate, just eager. Small lift at the end like she can see it happening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 歩道橋渡ると近道だぞ。
lines.en: Taking the pedestrian bridge cuts the walk in half, actually.
lines.style: Practical offer delivered lightly, almost like a gift of knowledge. Quiet confidence. Not lecturing — just someone who's thought ahead and is sharing. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解!帰りはアイス食べて帰ろ。
lines.en: Got it! We're hitting ice cream on the way back, though.
lines.style: Sealed the deal energy. Quick, decisive. Genuine pleasure in the closing — like the best part is already agreed. Small satisfied exhale after the full stop.
